faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about URNID SOLUTIONS and ElectroStock
faq.a1: URNID SOLUTIONS is a software company that builds SaaS tools for small and medium businesses. Our mission is to simplify business operations through intuitive, modern software.
faq.a2: ElectroStock is our flagship product — a stock management system designed specifically for electrical supply businesses. It handles inventory tracking, sales management, analytics, and more.
faq.q3: Can I try ElectroStock for free?
faq.a3: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required. After the trial, you can choose a plan that fits your needs.
faq.q4: What kind of support do you offer?
faq.a4: Starter plans include email support. Business plans include priority support. Enterprise customers get a dedicated account manager with guaranteed response times.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption for data at rest and in transit. Regular backups, strict access controls, and compliance with data protection regulations ensure your information is safe.
faq.q6: Can I customize the solution for my business?
faq.a6: Enterprise plans include custom integrations and tailored features. Contact our sales team to discuss your specific requirements.
